name: Payoff Daily Story Engine
one_line: One topic a day becomes a blog post, a 30-second reel and the social copy, all telling the same story. Nothing goes live without Nikunj merging the preview.

1.name: Mon · Teardown
1.job: A real brand with real budget, taken apart in public: what it buries, and the move. Always ends on something the brand is doing right. Needs an Ad Signals (Meta Ad Library) pass by Nikunj before merge.

2.name: Tue · Story Rules
2.job: One storytelling rule, shown on a D2C example the reader recognises.

3.name: Wed · Ad Lab
3.job: One Meta-ads creative problem (hooks, fatigue, testing, briefs) and the fix.

4.name: Thu · Cost & Choice
4.job: Buyer-intent SEO: what something costs in India, or X vs Y. Real price ranges with sources.

5.name: Fri · Craft Cut
5.job: Behind the craft: one shot, edit, light or sound decision, from 8+ years on set. First-hand by definition.

6.name: Sat · Founder Notes
6.job: A lesson from running Payoff this week. Honest, specific, no invented wins.

0.name: Sun · Culture Watch
0.job: One platform or culture change (Meta, Instagram, YouTube, ASCI) and what Indian D2C brands should do about it. Must cite the primary source.

video.music: Artlist catalog track (instrumental, 90-120 BPM), downloaded under Nikunj's plan. Optional; captions carry the reel without sound.

images.source: Payoff Studio cloud (MuAPI) — default model nano-banana-pro; fallback flux-2-pro
images.style: Editorial, filmic, Payoff palette (red #D52204, cream #FFD9A1, ink #241A15). One clear subject, real Indian D2C context, natural skin, shallow depth of field, 35mm grain. No text in the image, no logos, no real brands' packaging, no recognisable real people.
images.label: AI image

brand_rules.retired_logos: Never use the warped/blurred grotesque wordmark or any other older logo.
brand_rules.cta: Free 60-second teardown (/#teardown) unless the post sells something specific
brand_rules.facts: No invented numbers, clients, results or testimonials. Every stat links to its original source.

schedule.daily_run: 06:41 IST every day — writes the day's story, renders the reel, opens the preview PR, notifies
schedule.weekly_plan: Sunday 18:37 IST — fills next Monday to Sunday in the calendar
schedule.review: Nikunj reviews the preview + reel, merges the PR (= blog live), posts the reel with the caption
